title: SciTeX exchange ledger record, spec_version 1
description: One row per A->B exchange. Every exchange yields the same shape, so 'what happened to request X' is a lookup rather than an investigation. STORAGE IS NORMATIVE: this record is a record kind in scitex_dev.store (ADR-0006), never a hand-rolled file. That gives per-host storage, oplog directed replay between hosts, HLC ordering and no delete verb — so an exchange opened on the laptop is answerable from compute-04, and the ack and the completion are both still readable afterwards.

exchange_id.description: Identity. Issued by B on receipt, returned in the immediate ack before any work is done, and quoted by A in every follow-up. Time-ordered as text, attributable to the issuing host, unique without coordination.

opened_at.description: UTC ISO-8601. When B issued the id.

updated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601. When the latest status was written. Merges by MAX.

final.description: Is the latest status terminal? A 202 is NOT final. This is the field that makes an unanswered exchange FINDABLE: `final = false` with an old `updated_at` is the query for work that was accepted and never concluded — the state that was invisible on 2026-08-11 and had to be reconstructed by hand.
